games.title: Language Choice
games.description: Choose the form that makes the unit language accurate.

rounds.prompt: Choose the correct form: The river ______ by industrial waste last year.
rounds.answer: was polluted
rounds.explanation: The time phrase 'last year' places the action in the past, so the past passive 'was polluted' is needed.

rounds.prompt: Choose the correct form: Endangered animals must ______ by law.
rounds.answer: be protected
rounds.explanation: After a modal verb such as must, the passive always uses be plus the past participle: must be protected.

rounds.prompt: Choose the correct form: She is interested in ______ about renewable energy.
rounds.answer: learning
rounds.explanation: A verb that follows a preposition such as 'in' must take the -ing form, so 'interested in learning' is correct.

games.title: Reading Detective
games.description: Use unit evidence to solve each reading clue.

rounds.prompt: Where did Amal's class go on their expedition, and how long did the bus journey take?
choices: They went to the Boni National Reserve, one of Kenya's least-visited protected forests, and the bus journey took three hours.
They collected only firewood that had already fallen, did not break any living branches, and filtered water from the stream.
The note said the projector was hidden behind the old library, and there Jamal found the missing device wrapped in a sack, still working.
rounds.answer: They went to the Boni National Reserve, one of Kenya's least-visited protected forests, and the bus journey took three hours.
rounds.explanation: The opening tells you the class was beginning a two-day expedition to the Boni National Reserve, one of Kenya's least-visited protected forests, and the text then says the journey took three hours by bus.

rounds.prompt: How did the students take care of the environment at their campsite?
choices: Trees along the bank have been cut down, and without tree roots the soil erodes and the river becomes shallower.
Performing the copyrighted play without permission would have broken copyright law, so Jamal persuaded the group to collaborate on an original play about school life.
They collected only firewood that had already fallen, did not break any living branches, and filtered water from the stream.
rounds.answer: They collected only firewood that had already fallen, did not break any living branches, and filtered water from the stream.
rounds.explanation: Look at the paragraph about setting up camp: the students collected firewood that had already fallen, did not break any living branches, and filtered water from the stream, so they harmed nothing living.

rounds.prompt: What did the anonymous note under Jamal's pillow say, and what did he discover because of it?
choices: He believed that true leadership is about growth rather than power, so he stepped down early to let a new leader take over with fresh ideas.
The note said the projector was hidden behind the old library, and there Jamal found the missing device wrapped in a sack, still working.
Trees along the bank have been cut down, and without tree roots the soil erodes and the river becomes shallower.
rounds.answer: The note said the projector was hidden behind the old library, and there Jamal found the missing device wrapped in a sack, still working.
rounds.explanation: You must join the note's message to the discovery scene that closes part 1: the projector was moved, not stolen.
